Indian Passport Rank Declines in Global Index

The Indian passport has seen a decline in its global ranking, now positioned at 125th according to the 2026 Global Passport Index. This places it behind several other nations and represents a slip from its previous standing. The index assesses passport power based on visa-free access to countries.
